name: bld2_expanding_compact_isometryEquiv
statement: {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : X → X) (hf : ∀ x y : X, dist x y ≤ dist (f x) (f y)) : ∃ e : X ≃ᵢ X, ∀ x : X, e x = f x
closed: ∀ {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : X → X) (hf : ∀ x y : X, dist x y ≤ dist (f x) (f y)), ∃ e : X ≃ᵢ X, ∀ x : X, e x = f x
informal: Uses Mathlib2.top_expanding_compact_isometry and Mathlib2.top_isometry_compact_surjective: an expanding self-map of a compact metric space is an isometry, hence surjective; with injectivity of isometries this gives a bijective isometry, packaged as an IsometryEquiv.
type: ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : X → X), (∀ (x y : X), dist x y ≤ dist (f x) (f y)) → ∃ e, ∀ (x : X), e x = f x
